name: Brutalism
core_principles: honesty of material and structure — nothing is disguised
scale and mass used as the primary expressive tools
confrontation with the viewer rather than accommodation
rejection of polish as a marker of value
visual_traits: oversized type that breaks or exceeds the frame
extreme contrast with hard unmodulated edges
exposed structural elements — rules, borders, visible containers
deliberate density and collision between elements
unrefined default forms used without apology
composition: Confrontational and heavy. Elements are large, close and structurally tense, with collisions treated as intentional. The composition asserts rather than invites, and comfort is deliberately withheld.

grid.logic: A visible, often exposed grid used as a structural statement — borders and dividing rules left on show. Elements may deliberately break the structure at a single point of maximum tension.

typography.logic: Enormous scale contrast between one dominant word and everything else. Heavy weights, tight tracking, type allowed to crop against edges. Legibility is pushed to its limit but not past it.

color.logic: Stark high-contrast pairs, frequently monochrome with one aggressive accent. Colour is used as force rather than as classification or mood.

imagery: High contrast, coarse and unretouched. Visible grain, hard shadow and mechanical reproduction artefacts are kept rather than corrected.
materiality: Raw and unfinished. Board-marked concrete, exposed fixings, coarse paper, visible print registration and screen texture.
shape_language: Heavy blocks, thick rules and hard rectangles. Nothing rounded, nothing softened, no gradient or shadow used for comfort.
anti_stereotype: Ugliness is not the principle. The movement is about structural honesty and mass; deliberately bad spacing and clashing colour without a structural argument is just poor craft using the name as cover.

This is a high-risk choice against trust pressure. In categories where credibility is the primary job — healthcare, finance, property investment — the confrontational register works against the communication objective and doctrine requires it to lose.
Default system fonts and unstyled borders are a web-era mannerism of the revival, not the movement itself. The underlying idea is exposed structure, which can be executed with great precision.
